name: Awesome Black Friday / Cyber Monday for Mac Apps (s1ntoneli)
accepts: macOS apps, Mac-compatible tools and AI apps. Mac App Store apps that also run on iPhone are listed. iPhone-only apps do not fit.
how_to_submit: Pull request adding a row at the end of the category table in README.md. The table is HTML (table, tr, td), not a Markdown pipe table. Several apps in one pull request have been merged.
entry_format: with six cells: badge (🔥 50% or more, 💎 20 to 49%, ✨ under 20%), Name, type with platforms, description, offer (30% OFF · BF2026, or 'No code needed'), 2026 dates (Nov 4 - Dec 15, 2026).
rules: The pull request must include: the official product link, a short description and category, the platform, the exact saving and who qualifies, the code or 'No code needed', the 2026 start and end dates, and a disclosure if you are the maker or receive referral or affiliate compensation.
Current-year deals only. Maintainers may shorten descriptions, group many listings from one publisher, or decline deals that cannot be checked.
If the app is already listed, edit its row rather than adding a second one. No per-maker or per-pull-request limit.

Branch from the current main and rebase if you fall behind. The README gets several merges a day; conflicting pull requests have been closed with the maintainer adding the entry on main himself, and stale 2025 coupons were closed.
status_note: 79 pull requests from outside authors merged since 1 Oct 2026, the latest on 19 Nov 2026; 46 open; 15 closed without a merge.
recommended_for: Mac apps and Mac-compatible tools; a Mac app with an iPhone version is fine, iPhone-only is not
